import json, re def slugify(text: str) -> str: """Convert text to URL-friendly slug format.""" if not text: return '' cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text.lower()).strip('-') return cleaned if cleaned else '' def transform_item(item: dict) -> dict: """ Transform car item from Autoworld format to Shopify format. Optimized with better error handling and validation. """ row = {} # Title and handle with fallback title = item.get('title') or f"{item.get('brand', '')} {item.get('model', '')}".strip() stock_id = item.get('stockId') or item.get('vin') or '' row['Title'] = title base_slug = slugify(title) row['Handle'] = f"{base_slug}-{stock_id}" if base_slug and stock_id else (base_slug or stock_id) # SKU - use VIN first, fallback to stockId vin = item.get('vin') or item.get('VIN') row['Variant SKU'] = vin if vin else stock_id row['Variant ID'] = '' # Vendor and metadata row['Vendor'] = 'Autoworld' row['Metafield: custom.nr_dos_ [single_line_text_field]'] = stock_id # Pricing with validation gross_price = item.get('priceEur') row['Variant Price'] = str(gross_price) if gross_price is not None else '' if gross_price is not None: try: gross_float = float(gross_price) if gross_float > 0: net = gross_float / 1.21 row['Metafield: custom.pret_fara_tva [single_line_text_field]'] = f"{net:.2f}" else: row['Metafield: custom.pret_fara_tva [single_line_text_field]'] = '' except (ValueError, TypeError, ZeroDivisionError): row['Metafield: custom.pret_fara_tva [single_line_text_field]'] = '' else: row['Metafield: custom.pret_fara_tva [single_line_text_field]'] = '' # Type and tags row['Type'] = item.get('body') or '' tag_values = [ item.get('brand'), item.get('model'), item.get('year'), item.get('fuel'), item.get('transmission'), item.get('body'), item.get('color') ] row['Tags'] = ', '.join(str(t).strip() for t in tag_values if t) # Images - store as JSON array for later processing row['Image Src'] = item.get('images') row['Image Alt Text'] = title # Transmission and model row['Metafield: custom.cutie_viteze [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('transmission') model_raw = item.get('model') or '' model_tokens = model_raw.split() row['Metafield: custom.model [single_line_text_field]'] = ' '.join(model_tokens[:2]) if model_tokens else model_raw row['Metafield: custom.marca [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('brand') or '' # Power calculations hp = item.get('horsepower') if hp is not None: try: hp_val = float(hp) if hp_val > 0: kw_val = hp_val * 0.7355 row['Metafield: custom.putere_kw [single_line_text_field]'] = str(int(round(kw_val))) row['Metafield: custom.putere_cp [single_line_text_field]'] = str(int(round(hp_val))) except (ValueError, TypeError): pass # Additional metafields row['Metafield: custom.transmisie [list.single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('drivetrain') row['Metafield: custom.tva [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('vatType') or '' disp = item.get('displacementCc') row['Metafield: custom.cilindree [single_line_text_field]'] = str(disp) if disp else '' row['Metafield: custom.culoare [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('color') or '' row['Metafield: custom.km [single_line_text_field]'] = str(item.get('mileageKm')) if item.get('mileageKm') is not None else '' row['Metafield: custom.data_livrarii [single_line_text_field]'] = str(item.get('year')) if item.get('year') else '' row['Metafield: custom.body_type [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('body') or '' row['Metafield: custom.fuel [single_line_text_field]'] = item.get('fuel') or '' row['Metafield: custom.dotari [multi_line_text_field]'] = item.get('features') row['Features'] = item.get('features') # Build comprehensive Body HTML body_html_parts = [] brand = item.get('brand', '') model = item.get('model', '') year = item.get('year', '') if brand or model or year: overview = f"

{brand} {model}".strip() if year: overview += f" ({year})" overview += "

" body_html_parts.append(overview) # Technical specifications tech_specs = [] if item.get('fuel'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Combustibil: {item.get('fuel')}
    • ") if item.get('transmission'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Transmisie: {item.get('transmission')}
    • ") if item.get('body'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Caroserie: {item.get('body')}
    • ") if item.get('color'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Culoare: {item.get('color')}
    • ") if item.get('displacementCc'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Cilindree: {item.get('displacementCc')} cm³
    • ") if item.get('horsepower'): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Putere: {item.get('horsepower')} CP
    • ") mileage = item.get('mileageKm') if mileage is not None: try: mileage_val = float(mileage) if mileage_val >= 0: km_formatted = f"{int(mileage_val):,}".replace(",", ".") tech_specs.append(f"
  • Kilometraj: {km_formatted} km
    • ") except (ValueError, TypeError): tech_specs.append(f"
  • Kilometraj: {mileage} km
    • ") if item.get('drivetrain'): drivetrain_norm = item.get('drivetrain') if drivetrain_norm: tech_specs.append(f"
  • Tracțiune: {drivetrain_norm}
    • ") if tech_specs: body_html_parts.append("

    Specificații Tehnice:

    ") body_html_parts.append(f"
      {''.join(tech_specs)}
    ") # Features extra_desc = item.get('features') if extra_desc: body_html_parts.append("

    Dotări și Opțiuni:

    ") features_html = item.get('features') body_html_parts.append(f"
      {features_html}
    ") # Additional info additional_info = [] if item.get('vatType'): additional_info.append(f"
  • TVA: {item.get('vatType')}
    • ") if vin: additional_info.append(f"
  • VIN: {vin}
    • ") if stock_id: additional_info.append(f"
  • Cod stoc: {stock_id}
    • ") if additional_info: body_html_parts.append("

    Informații Adiționale:

    ") body_html_parts.append(f"
      {''.join(additional_info)}
    ") # Contact info body_html_parts.append("""

    Pentru mai multe informații contactați Autoworld!

    Toate vehiculele sunt verificate și pregătite pentru livrare.

    """) row['Body HTML'] = ''.join(body_html_parts) return row # Process all items output = [] for in_item in items: try: record = in_item.get('json', {}) output.append({'json': transform_item(record)}) except Exception as e: # Log error but continue processing print(f"Error transforming item: {str(e)}") continue return output

nodes.name: Routing Note
nodes.notes:
SMART ROUTING

Unified Filter determines:
- CREATE: New products
- UPDATE: Existing products (price changes)
- DEACTIVATE: Products no longer in source

Each action flows to its specific handler
